correctness.rationale: For Cr_n=K_{n,n} minus a matching, the unselected a_i signatures are V\{i} in the b-side and the unselected b_j signatures U\{j} in the a-side. Signature distinctness is equivalent to at most one completely unselected matched pair; nonemptiness contributes precisely the small-side exclusions. For n≥4 this gives (2z+z²)^n+n(2z+z²)^(n-1)-2n² z^(n-1)-2nz^n. The n=3 overlap correction restores six z² terms; n=2 is two disjoint edges. Independent direct-neighborhood subset enumeration n=2..7 agreed coefficient by coefficient. The first nonzero coefficient for n≥5 is n(2^(n-1)-2n) at degree n-1; at n=4 this vanishes, consistent with the boundary. Independent vertex omissions of probability q give Bin(n,q²) empty pairs and negligible small-side exceptions for q=c/√n; hence (1+c²)e^(-c²). Infinite formula is proved combinatorially, not by finite testing.
